cues.name: The request
cues.picture: your desk in the evening; you ask an agent for a search bar and try it

cues.name: Nothing happens
cues.picture: the button does nothing; the agent never tried it

cues.name: Ten agents
cues.picture: one agent becomes ten and the evening slips away testing them by hand

cues.name: The laptop struggles
cues.picture: all the copies start at once and the laptop overheats

cues.name: Morning
cues.picture: morning light; the laptop is calm and verifique appears

cues.name: Handing it in
cues.picture: agents hand in their work and keep going; a separate agent tests it

cues.name: Nothing happens again
cues.picture: the same broken button, caught by verifique this time

cues.name: Sent back and fixed
cues.picture: the work goes back to its agent with what went wrong, and it is fixed

cues.name: It works
cues.picture: the results come up and the proof is saved

cues.name: You come back
cues.picture: a bright morning, a coffee, and a shop that works

chunks.text:
[The request]
{Solo piano introduces a simple, gentle main theme, light and a little curious, with soft strings coming in quietly beneath it.}
positive_styles: main theme introduced on solo piano

chunks.text:
[Nothing happens]
{The music thins to a few slow, quiet piano notes over one soft held string note, thoughtful and a little deflated.}

[Ten agents]
{A flowing piano figure with gentle forward motion, busier as more strings join, the evening passing, growing a little weary.}

[The laptop struggles]
{Strings grow uneasy and restless under a repeating piano figure, tense but never loud, then settle onto a quiet held chord.}

[Morning]
{The main theme returns on piano, warm and clear, as the strings open up like morning light, calm and hopeful.}

[Handing it in]
{A light, steady, flowing piano figure over soft strings, orderly and unhurried, with quiet curiosity building towards the end.}

[Nothing happens again]
{The music thins to the same few slow, quiet piano notes over one soft held string note.}

[Sent back and fixed]
{Gentle forward motion returns on piano, purposeful and quietly confident, with strings slowly gathering.}

[It works]
{The main theme lifts on piano and strings, warm and bright, a quiet moment of relief, then it settles.}

[You come back]
{The main theme on solo piano with soft strings beneath, peaceful and warm, ending softly on a long held chord that fades to silence.}
